title: Concept: go.mod without a language version directive
description: go.mod declares a `go.mod` that declares no `go` version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The toolchain falls back to its own default language semantics, so two machines can build the same tree with different rules.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The toolchain falls back to its own default language semantics, so two machines can build the same tree with different rules.
